description: This file implements the routine for handling PDU session resource modification, including processing responses from various network components (E1AP, NGAP, RRC), managing PDU session modifications, and generating appropriate responses. It contains functions for handling bearer context modifications, UE context modifications, RRC reconfiguration, and final response generation.

classes.name: pdu_session_resource_modification_routine
classes.description: Main class implementing the routine for handling PDU session resource modification, including processing network responses and generating final responses.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_modification_response
methods.description: Processes the response from bearer context modification, updates response message and next configuration.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_modification_response
methods.description: Processes the response from UE context modification, updates response message and next configuration.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reconfiguration_response
methods.description: Handles the RRC reconfiguration response, marking all sessions as failed if reconfiguration failed.

methods.name: generate_pdu_session_resource_modify_response
methods.description: Generates the final response message for PDU session resource modification, applying configuration updates or marking sessions as failed.
